body.name: auxiliary-invariant fuzzy-hypothesis handle
body.construction: Construct \(\Pi_0\) and \(\Pi_1\) by best-polynomial-approximation duality so that they induce exactly the same random \(P_{XA}\), separate \(\tau(P)\) only through conditional outcome marks, match every likelihood monomial through the chosen degree whenever it contains a labeled mark, and are normalized into \(\mathcal M_{d,\epsilon}\) with a reservoir cell before transfer from independent Poisson counts to the fixed \((n,m)\) experiment.
